praises: 14-inch 3K-class Dynamic AMOLED 120Hz touch at $1,799 sale is arguably the best display-per-dollar in any Windows ultrabook at Best Buy CA right now
True blacks + HDR punch make video and dark-room use far better than any IPS competitor at this price
Still ~1.16 kg with 12+ h real battery despite the brighter AMOLED
Thunderbolt 4 + Wi-Fi 7 + Copilot+ NPU at a midrange sale price
Galaxy ecosystem pairing (Quick Share, Second Screen, S Pen input on the touch panel)
complaints: 16GB soldered is thin for a 'Pro' badge at $2,500 list
iGPU only — 'Pro' here means screen and portability, not creator GPU power
Glossy AMOLED reflects a lot in bright rooms
Samsung bloatware; Samsung Settings quirks after updates
512GB only at this tier (the 1TB lives on the cheaper non-Pro)

design_philosophy: The Book6 Pro is Samsung's 'AMOLED-first' ultrabook: the Pro badge buys the flagship Dynamic AMOLED 2x touch panel, Thunderbolt 4, and Wi-Fi 7 on the same Lunar Lake platform as the base line. At its $1,799.99 sale price this 14-inch tier collapses the usual premium gap — it undercuts even its own non-Pro siblings and is the configuration that best expresses the line's philosophy of phone-grade display tech in a Windows ultrabook.
